in_marathi.name: Geetanjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song of the God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geetanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetanjali is derived from two Sanskrit words – Geeta (song) and Jali (flowers). The name symbolizes the flow of spiritual songs or mantras, which is a source of enlightenment and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Saraswati, the goddess of wisdom and knowledge.
